title: Derived finding
description: A machine-derived determination (ADR-0009). Distinct from the kernel finding.v1: it carries no human `basis`, because its ground is not documentary, attested, or elective but mechanical and fully pinned. Its authority is located in the attribution chain — pins -> publication act -> adoption act -> user — which is the Ontology recorded-instrument framing (the value belongs to the user the way a spreadsheet's results belong to the person who built the sheet). The role-bearing pins are that chain, and are mandatory (minItems 1); a bare id bag is rejected (ADR-0007 decision 3). The id is content-addressed (ADR-0007 decision 5), proven by portability tests, not constrained here beyond non-emptiness.
